title: t3cp/attempt/1: the exporter's output for one attempt, the per-attempt slice of t3cp/record/1

synthetic.description: Present only on development data from tools/t3cp/dev/synth-data.mjs; refused under data/.

contaminated.description: true: other load on the machine disturbed the attempt; false: the host guard checked it and found it clean; null: the host guard could not judge it (problem host_guard_unavailable)

metric_reasons.description: Per metric whose value is null although the attempt is valid, why: not_measured_saturated (a count taken by start time on a saturated attempt).

distribution_tolerance.description: The driver's recorded distribution tolerance for fixture-backed cells; null for fresh cells. A change starts a new reference window.

distribution_check.description: The driver's post-window check that the exercised threads are a plausible sample of the fixture (the sample is drawn with the record's seed, so the attempts of a cell share it): their p50 and p95 turn-item ratios to the fixture's, and its verdict (binomial: an exact two-sided test of the counts below the fixture's p50 and above its p95; ratio_tolerance: both ratios within the cell's distribution_tolerance). A failed check is the problem distribution_mismatch. Null when the cell has no fixture threads to match.

id.description: large-<migration>: an era fixture; -s<pct>: a scaled validation build; none: an empty database. Only plain large-<n> records are published.

sha.description: In a record: the public commit the harness version's tag points at, as pinned in tools/t3cp/public-refs.json. An attempt carries the commit its run reported; merge checks the four hashes below against the pin and replaces it with that public commit.

files_sha256.description: run.ts's identity.harness_files_sha256, by its exported harnessFilesSha256(): sha256 over the lines '<repository-relative path>\0<sha256 of the file>\n' for every file of the harness's run-time closure (package.json, tools/server-bench, apps/server/scripts/dev-replay-agent.ts and the recordings), sorted by path, tests, docs and generated state excluded.

driver_sha256.description: run.ts's knobs.workload.driver_sha256, by its exported driverHash(): sha256 over '<name>\0<sha256>\n' lines for the load driver, its module directory and the local modules they import.

fakes_sha256.description: run.ts's knobs.workload.fakes_sha256, by its exported fakesHash(): sha256 over '<path>\0<sha256>\n' lines for the replaying fake providers' files (fake-claude, fake-codex, fake-acp, fake-common; tests and READMEs excluded) and the local modules they import.

preload_sha256.description: run.ts's identity.preload.sha256: sha256 over the lines '<file name>\0<sha256 of the file>\n' for the preload file the run loaded (by default tools/server-bench/preload/bench-preload.cjs; run.ts --preload names another) and then bench-preload.mjs in that file's directory, each when present; null when the run loaded no preload.

kind.description: base: an upstream tree built from source at a fork release's merge-base SHA

paired_nightly.description: Only on a nightly fork-head record (record_id <date>.<platform>.fork): the upstream nightly of the night it was measured beside, whose date is the record id's. Absent on every other record.

record_id.description: <date>.<platform>.nightly (a nightly); <version>.<platform>.fork (a fork release); <date>.<platform>.fork (the nightly fork-head record: the fork's latest release measured on that night, with paired_nightly); <first 12 hex of the merge-base SHA>.<platform>.base (a base record).

build.description: Fork and base records: the public repository the tree was built from (its commit is release.sha) and the build script's sha256; the built t3 is binary_sha256. Null for nightlies (the upstream archive).

cells.description: Per cell, the load arguments the runner ran it with (agents = sessions); written by the merge, absent on attempts.
